name: cloudfront-secure-media-foundation
description: CDK app that deploys the secure media streaming infrastructure (Cognito, S3, CloudFront, edge auth, token-vending API).

scripts.deploy: cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json && node scripts/write-frontend-config.mjs
scripts.deploy:lambda-edge: cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json -c authMode=lambda-edge && node scripts/write-frontend-config.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudfront-function: cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json -c authMode=cloudfront-function && node scripts/write-frontend-config.mjs
